commits.message: fix(console): log is a grid row beside print's rows; one Form classifier for Pretty (rich-console-5k3)
fix(console): log's time is a gutter print draws, cropped and base-styled with its row (rich-console-5k3)

fix(console): log draws print's output in a column beside the time; review fixes (rich-console-5k3)

A container is a block in print, so log split the timestamp from a logged
object. log now lays the time out as the reference's LogRender does.
Scalar data joins its text run as one RichText; _shape asks describesItself
directly again; isExpandable returns boolean; docs name the exact rule.

fix(console): print gives a container lines of its own, as Rich does (rich-console-5k3)

A container argument (array, typed array, Map, Set, or an object without its
own toString — Pretty's `isExpandable`, Rich's `is_expandable`) is now a block
in `Console.print`, like any renderable: `print("a", { x: 1 }, "b")` prints
three lines, as Rich fc41075a does. Scalars still join the text run.

`isExpandable` is the one definition of "container": `_shape` reads its text
arm from it, so print and Pretty cannot disagree.

fix(release): declare repository; refuse a publish missing its entry points (0.18.1) (#228)

* fix(release): declare repository and refuse a publish missing its entry points; release 0.18.1

publish.yml failed E422 because package.json had no repository, so
provenance could not verify (rich-release-24l). The laptop fallback then
published 0.18.0 with no dist/ (deprecated): prepublishOnly now refuses any
tree missing a file main/types/exports declares.

* fix(release): entry-points guard reads npm's pack listing and cannot fail open

- main() runs unconditionally: the argv[1] check exited 0 unchecked through any
  symlinked path (macOS tmpdir included)
- what ships is asked of `npm pack --dry-run --json`, not the disk
- every missing entry point is named, on one stderr channel
- tests run a byte copy against real fixture packages, pin the prepublishOnly
  wiring and the repository field; publish.yml and CLAUDE.md name the gate

* fix(release): drop the unreachable npm.cmd branch

fix(renderables): every exported renderable ends its own line or is listed as a fragment (rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq)

Spinner, Status, Pretty, JSON and a Layout leaf left their last line open,
so a Group ran what followed onto it; Rich ends all five. test/seam/line-ends.ts
derives every exported Renderable class and requires an entry saying which
side of the line it sits on, rendering each to check. ProgressBar, Emoji and
the Progress columns are fragments, as in Rich.
